slides.texte_overlay:
5 loneliest drives a man
could ever take

1. The Drive Home From the Airport
Alone:

The empty passenger seat.
The goodbye still in your chest.
The radio too loud.

2. The Drive After Your Last Shift
at a Job You Loved:

The badge on the dash.
The parking lot in the mirror.
A chapter closed.

3. The Drive to Your Parents'
When They Need Help:

The roles quietly flipped.
You're the one they call now.

4. The Drive After You Decided
to Change Everything:

New habits. New plan.
A lesson a day.
Nobody knows yet. You do.
slides.texte_sophia:
4. The Drive After You Decided
to Change Everything:

New habits. A lesson a day
on the Sophia app.
Nobody knows yet. You do.

slides.texte_overlay:
5. The Drive Home After
You Finally Made It:

The same road as always.
It just looks different now.
